question: What can be the suitable title of the passage?
solution:
The correct answer is "**All about earthquake.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• A title is a passage's first impression. It explains all about the theme of the passage.
 
• Now, in case of the given passage:
 
 
• **When we summarize all three paragraphs, it can be clear that the passage is a detailed information about the earthquakes.**
 
 
 
• The options 2, 3 and 4 are only the parts of the passage.
 
• Therefore, it is clear that the given passage is "all about earthquakes."

Hence, **the correct answer is option 1**.
